Subject: Quick tailored walkthrough — spotted high activity on your trial

Hi Sana,

Saw BrightLayer cross ~200k tokens in the last 48 hours — congrats on the early traction. That usage pattern usually means teams get a lot more value with a quick, focused walkthrough to cover: the best model/config for your prompt mix, batching & caching tips to cut token costs, and an integration checklist for predictable latency in production.

If you have 30 minutes, I can run a short session tailored to how youre using the API (bring your engineers or product lead if youd like). Quick slot options that work on our side:
- Tue Sep 21 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed Sep 22 — 1:00–1:30 PM PT
- Thu Sep 23 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Or pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo

Ive attached a one-pager that highlights the areas we typically cover. If you prefer a short emails-only sync to start, say the word — otherwise, pick a slot and Ill send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
SDR, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.inference.com
